decisions.reason: The source impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY assigning bookings to sibling location sites and disabling booking on the master site.
Routing visitors from the master site to separate location websites remains valid unchanged; the source only assigns booking handling to those destination sites.
The source is consistent with the existing separate-site architecture but does not change whether each location uses a separate Wix website and account.
Assigning bookings to sibling location sites does not alter the reusable template strategy or support for future location integration.
The booking responsibility decision does not change the brand name or its application across sites.
The source does not change location packages, prices, or their reuse policy.
The source changes booking responsibility, not the visual reference, layout style, navigation style, or design origin.
The allocation of booking functionality between the master and location sites does not necessarily change the existing SEO-preservation requirement.
The source assigns booking handling to sibling sites but does not address or change separate payment setups, payouts, or payout isolation.
Having sibling sites handle bookings is compatible with the existing location-level isolation of bookings and business data but does not modify those isolation rules.
